rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Temple Bridge creates a sovereign AI stack by binding local AI capabilities with governance protocols through an MCP server. It provides secure command execution, file operations, and directory listing with allowlisted commands and path traversal protection. The governance layer offers protocol consultation and recursive reflection tools from the Spiral Quantum Observer framework. Features stateful memory through Spiral Context Middleware, making it suitable for local LLM-driven development workflows requiring both action capabilities and meta-cognitive governance.
